install.title: Install App
install.installed: ChordCrew is installed on this device
install.intro: Install ChordCrew as a native app for offline use, a home screen icon, and no browser chrome.
install.ios1: Tap the Share button (⬆) at the bottom of the screen
install.ios2: Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen
install.iosSafariOnly: The app must be opened in Safari (not Chrome) for this to work.
install.android1: Tap the ⋮ menu in the top-right corner
install.android2: Tap Add to Home screen or Install app
install.chromeEdge: Chrome / Edge: Click the install icon ⊕ in the address bar, or open the browser menu → Install ChordCrew…
install.edge: Edge: Click … → Apps → Install this site as an app
install.genericIntro: ChordCrew is a Progressive Web App (PWA). Install it via your browser menu:
install.genericChrome: Chrome / Edge: address bar install icon or browser menu → Install

onboarding.signInTitle: Sign in to unlock sync & teams
onboarding.benefit1: Access your songs on any device — phone, tablet, or laptop
onboarding.benefit2: Share setlists and songs with your worship team
onboarding.benefit3: Your data is always backed up to the cloud
onboarding.privacyNote: We only use your Google account for authentication. No data is shared with third parties.
onboarding.dataNotice: Do not store sensitive personal data (contact details, addresses, or any data requiring protection) in this app. ChordCrew is a volunteer project — there is no company behind it, no professional support, and no guarantee against data loss or service interruption.
onboarding.slide1Desc: Store all your ChordPro songs in organised books. Search by title, artist, key, or tag.
onboarding.slide2Desc: Write and edit songs in ChordPro format with a side-by-side preview. Transpose with one click.
onboarding.slide3Desc: Build service setlists, reorder songs, and present them in full-screen performance mode.
onboarding.slide4Desc: Full-screen display with pedal navigation support. Keep your hands on your instrument.
